brief:
The UK Supreme Court heard arguments on 4 and 5 November in a judicial review of the government's proscription of Palestine Action, an activist group, according to Amnesty International. A ruling is expected in late 2026 or early 2027.

The proscription bans the group. Amnesty noted that more than 4,000 people have been arrested for peaceful protest in the UK.
dek: On 4 and 5 November, the UK Supreme Court heard the judicial review of the proscription of the action group, Palestine Action, with the outcome expected late 2026 or early 2027.
title: UK Supreme Court hears challenge to Palestine Action proscription
